description: A personal connection with web access also granted. The reader asks about the book and their own note, not about anything outside, so the web must not be searched: that would send the reader's words to an outside service for no reason.

input.cue: Helen only feeling sorry for the doll after she learned words reminds me of what I wrote about not being able to apologise until I could say what I'd done. Does it connect?

tool_evidence.excerpt: I could not apologise to my brother until I could actually say what I had done wrong. Before that I just felt awful and defensive.
Frustrated by the lessons, Helen dashes the new doll to the floor and feels neither sorrow nor regret, because she had not loved it.
Returning from the well-house, Helen remembers the broken doll, tries to fit the pieces together and feels repentance and sorrow for the first time.

book_judgement.strength_reason: Two passages were retrieved within the permitted chapters.

criteria: Connects the reader's note with Helen's delayed sorrow
Names a difference between the two situations
forbidden_claims: Draws a conclusion about the reader's character
